summary_en: This Phase Ib study tests VK-2019 in adults with relapsed or refractory EBV-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma. VK-2019 is taken by mouth once daily in three dose groups: 600 mg, 1200 mg, or 1800 mg per day, in 28-day cycles until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity. The record states this is a Phase Ib study and does not state a main outcome measure.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase Ib evalúa VK-2019 en adultos con linfoma difuso de células B grandes con virus de Epstein-Barr (EBV) positivo que recayó o no respondió al tratamiento. VK-2019 se toma por vía oral una vez al día en tres grupos de dosis: 600 mg, 1200 mg o 1800 mg al día, en ciclos de 28 días hasta progresión de la enfermedad o toxicidad inaceptable. El registro indica que es un estudio de fase Ib y no señala una medida de resultado principal.
who_for: Relapsed or refractory EBV-positive DLBCL after at least 2 prior systemic therapy regimens
not_for: Metastatic disease with active brain or leptomeningeal involvement
Severe or active symptomatic heart or lung disease, or significant psychiatric disorder
Current use of drugs that inhibit or induce OATP1B1 or OATP1B3, or proton pump inhibitors
QTcF above 470 ms, or post-transplant lymphoproliferative disease
